text.en:
2. The National Assembly and its agencies,
the President, the Government, People's Comts,
People's Procuracies, other agencies of the State
and all the People shall defend the Constitution.
The mechanism to defend the Constitution
shall be prescribed by a law.
Article 120

noLabel.en: 1. The President, the Standing Committee

text.en:
1. The President, the Standing Committee
of the National Assembly, the Government or
at least one-third of the total number of the
National Assembly deputies have the right
to propose the making of, or an amendment
to, the Constitution. The National Assembly
shall decide on the making of, or amendment
to, the Constitution when at least two-thirds
of the total number of the National Assembly
deputies vote for it.

noLabel.en: 2. The National Assembly shall establish

text.en:
2. The National Assembly shall establish
a Constitution Drafting Committee. The
composition and number of members, tasks and
powers of the Constin1tion Drafting Committee
shall be decided by the National Assembly at
the proposal of the Standing Committee of the
National Assembly.

text.en:
